# AAAI Open Journal System (OJS)

> Official open access publishing platform for AAAI conference proceedings, featuring peer-reviewed research in AI ethics, combinatorial search, and artificial intelligence.

The AAAI OJS platform hosts proceedings from major AAAI conferences and symposia, providing free access to cutting-edge research in artificial intelligence, ethics, and computational methods. It serves as a central repository for the Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence's flagship events.

## Key Topics

- AI Ethics
- AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES)
- International Symposium on Combinatorial Search (SOCS)
- Conference Proceedings
- Student Abstracts
- Responsible AI
- Artificial Intelligence
- Constraint Programming
- Planning and Robotics
- Fair Datasets
- AI Policy
- Interdisciplinary Research
- Academic Journal
- Research Papers
- AAAI Press

## AI Ethics and Society Conference

- [Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AIES): Main journal page for AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society proceedings
- [Vol. 8 No. 4 (2025): Proceedings of the Seventh AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES-25) - Student Abstracts II](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AIES/issue/current): Current volume of AIES-25 student abstracts and conference proceedings featuring research on responsible AI and ethical frameworks

## Combinatorial Search Symposium

- [Proceedings of the International Symposium on Combinatorial Search](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/SOCS): Main journal page for International Symposium on Combinatorial Search proceedings
- [Vol. 18 (2025): Eighteenth International Symposium on Combinatorial Search](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/SOCS/issue/current): Current volume 18 of Eighteenth International Symposium on Combinatorial Search featuring research in constraint programming and planning algorithms
